title: ORAV OTT JA KARU KATI TEEVAD SUPPI

characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike oranž orav suure koheva sabaga, kandmas rohelist kootud kampsunit, suured uudishimulikud rõõmsad silmad ja sõbralik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: KARU KATI
characters.description: Suur pehme pruuni karvaga karu (mitte roosa), ees kollane põll, soe ja sõbralik naeratus, ümarad kõrvad. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Õdus köök
locations.description: Cozy children's book kitchen with light blue wooden walls, light wooden floor, single square window on the back wall showing autumn rain drops and falling yellow leaves outside, round wooden dining table in center, red cooking pot standing directly on the table top (no stove or burner on the table), wooden cabinets along left wall, warm lighting. Cartoon style.
